terms.definition: Delegate only bounded, dependency-aware work with explicit inputs, output contract, permissions, write isolation, validation, and lead-agent reconciliation; a worker cannot expand authority or approve, commit, publish, or perform live-external actions for the lead.

A user-selected workspace mode changes bounded routing and supporting project information only; it cannot activate nested adapters or grant write scope, approval, permissions, authority, tools, or gate bypass.
non_meanings: application mode selects a dependency adapter
